item.title: Agility Robotics Plans $2.5 Billion SPAC Listing as Humanoid Partnerships Scale
item.summary: Agility Robotics plans to go public via a SPAC merger with Churchill Capital Corp XI at a ~$2.5 billion valuation, with $620M+ in expected gross proceeds and a self-reported $300 million commercial backlog for its Digit humanoid robots deployed under a robots-as-a-service model.
